name: Atari-100k
description: Atari-100k data-efficient protocol: 26 games, 100 thousand steps, about two hours of play. Human-normalized median. Kaiser et al., ICLR 2020. Distinct from the full Atari-57 set. ROMs stay external and loader-only.

license.notes: ALE environment host. Game ROMs are loader-only and are not vendored.
